// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Gryphon kit (legacy boss port, 2026-11-16) ─────────────────────────────────

// Canvas-2D ports of the legacy-boss mockup's shared kit (part-common.js / part-engine.js) that the

// Gryphon's moves use: wind wisps, floor rings, dust, cracks, a growing floor shadow, a drawn crescent,

// projectiles (dart / wind ball / wind crescent), horizontal speed lines, rumble, afterimage ghosts.

// Every helper schedules timeline tracks at an absolute time (ms) instead of running in real time.

// Sizes are mockup px (1682 px stage) times KP; s = the depth factor of the body the effect sits on.

// Prepended after _zpkit (ZP.once / ZP.hit / ZP.flinchTok / ZP.cutin). No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const GK = {};

GK.make = (tl, m, KP, seed) => {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const R = tl.rng(seed || 77);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const K = {};

K.rnd = rnd;

const glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7); g.fill(); };

K.glow = glow;

// one particle = one track; fn(g, ageMs, u 0..1). comp: 'lighter' (the mockup particle default) or 'source-over'

const add = (at, life, z, fn, comp) => m.hold(at, at + life, (e, S) => { S.world.push({ z, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = comp || 'lighter'; try { fn(g, e, Math.min(1, e / life)); } catch (er) {} g.restore(); } }); });

K.add = add;

// depth factor of a timeline token relative to the caster ('k'), times KP

K.s = (k) => { const T = TOK[k]; if (!T || !TOK.k) return KP; return KP * tl.depthRatio(feet(TOK.k), feet(T)); };

K.center = (k) => { const T = TOK[k], f = feet(T); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - T.h * 0.5 }; };

K.feet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

// floor ring (ground layer, under the bodies)

K.ring = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy || 0.3, w = o.w || 6, s = o.s || KP;

add(at, ms, 2, (g, e, t) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, E.outC(t)) * s; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - t) + ')'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, w * (1 - t * 0.6) * s); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, Math.max(0.1, r), Math.max(0.1, r * sy), 0, 0, 7); g.stroke(); }); };

// ground cracks

K.crack = (at, pt, s) => { s = s || KP; const segs = []; for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) segs.push([rnd(0, Math.PI * 2), rnd(30, 80)]);

add(at, 1600, 3, (g, e, t) => { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,18,10,' + (t > 0.7 ? (1 - t) / 0.3 * 0.8 : 0.8) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3 * s;

for (const sg of segs) { const a = sg[0], L = sg[1]; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y); g.lineTo(pt.x + Math.cos(a) * L * s * 0.5, pt.y + Math.sin(a) * L * s * 0.16); g.lineTo(pt.x + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * L * s, pt.y + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * L * s * 0.32); g.stroke(); } }, 'source-over'); };

// dust puffs thrown up and out from a point (velocity decays with drag .97 per 16 ms)

K.dust = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, s = o.s || KP, rgb = o.rgb || '190,170,140'; const dk = -Math.log(0.97) / 16;

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp1 = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s, sp2 = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s, life = rnd(500, 900), r = rnd(8, 18) * s, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s;

add(at, life, 6, (g, e, t) => { const d = (1 - Math.exp(-dk * e)) / dk; const x = x0 + Math.cos(an) * sp1 * d, y = pt.y + Math.sin(an) * sp2 * d; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - t)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + t), 0, 7); g.fill(); }, 'source-over'); } };

// a floor shadow that grows over growMs (ease-in) and is removed at endAt

K.shadow = (at, growMs, endAt, pt, r, s) => { s = s || KP; add(at, Math.max(1, endAt - at), 2, (g, e) => { const k = E.inQ(Math.min(1, e / growMs)); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (0.55 * k) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, Math.max(0.1, r * k * s), Math.max(0.1, r * k * s * 0.32), 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); }, 'source-over'); };

// wind wisps: glowing motes that home in on a point along a curve (mockup homing, ease-in)

K.wisps = (at, to, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, rr = (o.r == null ? 220 : o.r) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '200,255,225', ms = o.ms || 700, arc = 60 * KP, pr = 2 * KP;

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rnd(0, Math.PI * 2); const from = { x: to.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y: to.y + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.6 };

const cx = (from.x + to.x) / 2 + rnd(-arc, arc), cy = Math.min(from.y, to.y) - rnd(arc * 0.3, arc), life = ms * rnd(0.85, 1.15);

const at2 = (q) => { const t = E.inQ(Math.min(1, q)), u = 1 - t; return { x: u * u * from.x + 2 * u * t * cx + t * t * to.x, y: u * u * from.y + 2 * u * t * cy + t * t * to.y }; };

add(at, life, 40, (g, e) => { const p = at2(e / life), q = at2(Math.max(0, e - 16) / life); glow(g, p.x, p.y, pr * 3.5, rgb, 0.95); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',.5)'; g.lineWidth = pr; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(q.x, q.y); g.lineTo(p.x, p.y); g.stroke(); }); } };

// a drawn crescent slash across a point; dir mirrors it for a caster facing left

K.crescent = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const ang = o.ang == null ? -0.5 : o.ang, len = (o.len || 160) * KP, w = (o.w || 26) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', ms = o.ms || 260, dir = o.dir || 1;

add(at, ms, 42, (g, e, t) => { const k = E.outC(Math.min(1, t * 1.6)); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.scale(dir, 1); g.rotate(ang); g.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, (t - 0.45) / 0.55);

g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',.9)'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len / 2, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -w * 1.6 * k, len / 2 * k, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -w * 0.4, -len / 2, 0); g.fill();

glow(g, 0, -w * 0.5, len * 0.45, rgb, 0.35); }); };

// a projectile from -> to over ms (ease), arcing up by arc px; draw(g, ageMs) with the tip at 0,0 pointing +x. Returns the arrival time.

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { o = o || {}; const ms = o.ms || 450, ease = o.ease || E.lin, arc = (o.arc || 0) * KP, draw = o.draw, sc = o.scale || KP;

const pos = (q) => { const u = ease(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, q))); return { x: lerp(from.x, to.x, u), y: lerp(from.y, to.y, u) - arc * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) }; };

add(at, ms, o.z || 44, (g, e) => { const p = pos(e / ms), q = pos((e - 16) / ms); let an = Math.atan2(p.y - q.y, p.x - q.x); if (!(Math.abs(p.x - q.x) + Math.abs(p.y - q.y) > 0.01)) an = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(an); g.scale(sc, sc); draw(g, e); });

return at + ms; };

K.SHAPE = {

dart: (g) => { g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#f4f1ea'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(-8, 0, 13, 3.2, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#8a6a4a'; g.fillRect(-22, -0.8, 12, 1.6); glow(g, 0, 0, 10, '220,255,230', 0.5); },

wind: (r, rgb) => { r = r || 26; rgb = rgb || '190,255,215'; return (g, e) => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.8 - i * 0.15) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, r * (1 - i * 0.18), e / 60 + i * 1.6, e / 60 + i * 1.6 + 3.6); g.stroke(); } glow(g, 0, 0, r * 1.2, rgb, 0.6); }; },

g.restore(); } }); }); };

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const ms = o.ms || 380, op = o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, filter = o.filter || 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; const T = TOK[k], art = tl.art(k); if (!T || !art) return;

g.scale(T.flip * (pose.sx || 1) * r, (pose.sy || 1) * r); g.drawImage(art, -T.w / 2, -T.h * T.foot, T.w, T.h); }, 'source-over'); };

const HOV = {};

};

// ── shot ──

// ── Gryphon · filler moves (shot) ───────────────────────────────────────────────

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup: Talon, Razor Plume, Airdrop, Air Blast, Aerial Shockwave,

// Turbulence Wind, Wind Wall. cfg.move picks one. LIVE board: the camera is never touched, only the

// bodies a beat moves are painted. Each move fires the damage gate where the mockup marks it.

// Every number is in cfg (mockup px on a 1682 px stage, x KP). No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const NEEDS = { talon: 1, razorplume: 1, airdrop: 1, airblast: 1, aerialshock: 1, turbulence: 1, windwall: 0 };

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.slice(0, cfg.maxTargets || 8).forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * G.s(k), y: f.y }; };

// his body track: fn(t) -> { dx, dy, air, sx, sy } or null (untouched)

const body = (t0, t1, fn) => m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => { const o = fn(e + t0); if (!o) return; const q = S.tok.k; q.dx += o.dx || 0; q.dy += o.dy || 0; q.air += o.air || 0; q.sx *= o.sx || 1; q.sy *= o.sy || 1; });

const walk = (t, a, ms, p0, p1, ease, hop) => { const u = seg(t, a, a + ms), e = ease(u); return { dx: lerp(p0.x, p1.x, e) - kf.x, dy: lerp(p0.y, p1.y, e) - kf.y, air: Math.sin(e * Math.PI) * (hop || 0) * KP }; };

// ── Talon: a short hopping lunge, a three-claw rake, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk), Tk = TOK[tk], tf = feet(Tk);

const DEST = front(tk, cfg.talonGap);

const L = cfg.lunge, RAKE = L, HIT = RAKE + 3 * 70, BACK = HIT + 300;

total = BACK + cfg.back; gate = HIT;

body(0, total, (t) => { if (t < L) return walk(t, 0, L, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 30); if (t < BACK) return { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y }; return walk(t, BACK, cfg.back, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 30); });

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const at = RAKE + i * 70;

G.crescent(at, { x: tf.x - DIR * 10 * s + DIR * i * 12 * s, y: tf.y - Tk.h * (0.7 - i * 0.15) }, { ang: 0.9, len: 120, w: 14, dir: DIR }); S_(at, A.sfx.slash1, 0.4); }

m.clip('claw', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('claw', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.blowL, 0.5);

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

}

if (MOVE === 'razorplume') {

// ── Razor Plume: a wing flap, then a fan of five feather darts at each target in turn ──

const FL = 140 + 160; S_(0, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

body(0, FL, (t) => { const q = t < 140 ? squash(t, 0, 140, [1, 1], [1.08, 0.9]) : squash(t, 140, 160, [1.08, 0.9], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

let at = FL;

for (const k of FOES.slice(0, 2)) { const f = feet(TOK[k]), Tk = TOK[k], s = G.s(k);

for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) G.fly(at, hand(), { x: f.x + rnd(-20, 20) * s, y: f.y - Tk.h * rnd(0.3, 0.7) }, { ms: 300 + i * 25, draw: G.SHAPE.dart, arc: rnd(-30, 30) });

S_(at, A.sfx.evade, 0.4);

const hitAt = at + 320; m.clip('hit_phys', hitAt, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('hit_phys', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hitAt, A.sfx.slash1, 0.35); G.hit(hitAt, k, 'normal');

at = hitAt + 160; }

gate = at; total = at + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'airdrop') {

// ── Airdrop: grab beside the grappled creature, climb with it, let go at the top, it slams into the floor ──

const tk = FOES[0], Tk = TOK[tk], f = feet(Tk), s = G.s(tk);

const DEST = (() => { const p = front(tk, cfg.grabGap); return { x: p.x, y: p.y + 2 * KP }; })();

const GRAB = cfg.grab, CLIMB = GRAB, TOP = CLIMB + cfg.climb, DROP = TOP + 150, LAND = DROP + cfg.drop, RET = LAND + 250;

total = RET + cfg.ret + 200; gate = LAND;

const UP = cfg.climbLift * KP, UPT = cfg.carryLift * KP;

body(0, RET + cfg.ret, (t) => {

if (t < GRAB) return walk(t, 0, GRAB, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 40);

const at = { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y };

if (t < RET) { at.air = UP * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); return at; }

const w = walk(t, RET, cfg.ret, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 0); w.air = UP * (1 - E.sine(seg(t, RET, RET + cfg.ret))); return w; });

S_(GRAB, A.sfx.blowL, 0.4); G.hit(GRAB, tk, 'normal', false);

S_(CLIMB, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

m.hold(CLIMB, LAND, (e, S) => { const t = e + CLIMB; const q = S.tok[tk]; let air;

if (t < TOP) air = UPT * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); else if (t < DROP) air = UPT; else air = UPT * (1 - E.inC(seg(t, DROP, LAND))); q.air += air; });

G.shadow(DROP, 350, LAND, f, 40, s);

S_(LAND, A.sfx.land, 0.6); S_(LAND, A.sfx.blowL, 0.6); m.shake(LAND, 360, 14);

G.dust(LAND, f, { n: 18, s: s * 1.3 }); G.ring(LAND, f, { r1: 160, w: 8, s }); G.crack(LAND, f, s);

G.hit(LAND, tk, 'strong');

}

// ── Air Blast: wind gathers at his hand, a green-white wind ball flies to the target and bursts ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk);

G.wisps(0, hand(), { n: 10, r: 90, ms: 400 }); S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.4);

const BALL = 450; S_(BALL, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

const HIT = G.fly(BALL, hand(), c, { ms: 480, arc: 40, ease: E.sine, draw: G.SHAPE.wind(24) });

m.clip('wind1', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('wind1', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5);

G.ring(HIT, feet(TOK[tk]), { rgb: '200,255,220', s });

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

gate = HIT; total = HIT + 400 + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'aerialshock') {

// ── Aerial Shockwave: a wing sweep, then three wind crescents in quick succession, one per target ──

body(0, 320, (t) => { const q = t < 160 ? squash(t, 0, 160, [1, 1], [1.1, 0.88]) : squash(t, 160, 160, [1.1, 0.88], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

const C0 = 320; let last = C0;

FOES.slice(0, 3).forEach((k, i) => { const at = C0 + i * 170; S_(at, A.sfx.wind7, 0.45);

const hit = G.fly(at, hand(), G.center(k), { ms: 380, draw: G.SHAPE.crs });

m.clip('wind2', hit, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('wind2', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hit, A.sfx.slash2, 0.3); G.hit(hit, k, 'normal'); last = at + 170; });

gate = last + 450; total = gate + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'turbulence') {

// ── Turbulence Wind: a wind spiral under each target and a light shake, then the debuff beat. No damage. ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5); G.rumble(0, 700, 2);

for (const k of FOES) { const s = G.s(k), f = feet(TOK[k]);

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) G.ring(0, f, { rgb: '190,255,215', r0: 60, r1: 10, ms: 700, s });

G.wisps(0, G.center(k), { n: 8, r: 70, ms: 600 });

m.clip('powerdown', 700, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: clipW('powerdown', 1), z: 30 }); }

gate = 700; total = 700 + 600 + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'windwall') {

// ── Wind Wall: a pale wind curtain rises in front of his own side, then the buff beat ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

const xw = kf.x + DIR * cfg.wallAhead * KP, ST = tl.STAGE;

for (let at = 0; at < 1300; at += 40) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const x = xw + rnd(-30, 30) * KP, y0 = ST.y + ST.h * rnd(250 / 788, 650 / 788), vy = rnd(0.25, 0.5) * KP, life = rnd(500, 900), r = rnd(30, 70) * KP;

G.add(at, life, 34, (g, e, t) => { const y = y0 - vy * e; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,255,230,' + (0.5 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI)) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 2 * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + 14 * KP, y - r / 2, x, y - r); g.stroke(); }); }

m.clip('powerup', 1300, { x: kf.x, y: kf.y, w: clipW('powerup', 1), z: 3 }); S_(1300, A.sfx.powerup, 0.35 / 0.75);

gate = 1300; total = 1300 + 800 + 300;

}

ZP.once(m, gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, sfx, onStart: () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } } });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

})();

// Talon — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"claw":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/016_claw_physical.webm","w":336,"h":336,"dur":400,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5774,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"overdrive":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav","shukuchi":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav","flash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Flash2.ogg","wind1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind1.ogg","wind4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","wind7":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg","damage5":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg","land":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_JUMPLANDA.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","slash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash2.ogg","evade":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Evasion1.ogg","powerup":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Powerup.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-gryphon-talon";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Talon]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: CL, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const G = GK.make(tl, m, KP, cfg.seed || 1170);

const rnd = G.rnd;

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at, url, v: v * cfg.volume }); };

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * CL[key].k * scale * KP;

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.x <= tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w / 2 ? 1 : -1);

// his "hand" (where wind and darts leave him): ahead of his middle, 62 % up his body

const hand = (air) => ({ x: kf.x + DIR * K.w * 0.3, y: kf.y - (air || 0) - K.h * 0.62 });

// a point in front of a target, on his side

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * G.s(k), y: f.y }; };

// his body track: fn(t) -> { dx, dy, air, sx, sy } or null (untouched)

const body = (t0, t1, fn) => m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => { const o = fn(e + t0); if (!o) return; const q = S.tok.k; q.dx += o.dx || 0; q.dy += o.dy || 0; q.air += o.air || 0; q.sx *= o.sx || 1; q.sy *= o.sy || 1; });

const squash = (t, a, ms, from, to) => { const u = E.outQ(seg(t, a, a + ms)); return [lerp(from[0], to[0], u), lerp(from[1], to[1], u)]; };

// a move along the floor from p0 to p1 with an optional hop (mockup moveActor)

const walk = (t, a, ms, p0, p1, ease, hop) => { const u = seg(t, a, a + ms), e = ease(u); return { dx: lerp(p0.x, p1.x, e) - kf.x, dy: lerp(p0.y, p1.y, e) - kf.y, air: Math.sin(e * Math.PI) * (hop || 0) * KP }; };

const HOME = { x: kf.x, y: kf.y };

let total = 0, gate = 0;

if (MOVE === 'talon') {

// ── Talon: a short hopping lunge, a three-claw rake, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk), Tk = TOK[tk], tf = feet(Tk);

const DEST = front(tk, cfg.talonGap);

const L = cfg.lunge, RAKE = L, HIT = RAKE + 3 * 70, BACK = HIT + 300;

total = BACK + cfg.back; gate = HIT;

body(0, total, (t) => { if (t < L) return walk(t, 0, L, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 30); if (t < BACK) return { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y }; return walk(t, BACK, cfg.back, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 30); });

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const at = RAKE + i * 70;

G.crescent(at, { x: tf.x - DIR * 10 * s + DIR * i * 12 * s, y: tf.y - Tk.h * (0.7 - i * 0.15) }, { ang: 0.9, len: 120, w: 14, dir: DIR }); S_(at, A.sfx.slash1, 0.4); }

m.clip('claw', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('claw', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.blowL, 0.5);

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

}

if (MOVE === 'razorplume') {

// ── Razor Plume: a wing flap, then a fan of five feather darts at each target in turn ──

const FL = 140 + 160; S_(0, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

body(0, FL, (t) => { const q = t < 140 ? squash(t, 0, 140, [1, 1], [1.08, 0.9]) : squash(t, 140, 160, [1.08, 0.9], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

let at = FL;

for (const k of FOES.slice(0, 2)) { const f = feet(TOK[k]), Tk = TOK[k], s = G.s(k);

for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) G.fly(at, hand(), { x: f.x + rnd(-20, 20) * s, y: f.y - Tk.h * rnd(0.3, 0.7) }, { ms: 300 + i * 25, draw: G.SHAPE.dart, arc: rnd(-30, 30) });

S_(at, A.sfx.evade, 0.4);

const hitAt = at + 320; m.clip('hit_phys', hitAt, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('hit_phys', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hitAt, A.sfx.slash1, 0.35); G.hit(hitAt, k, 'normal');

at = hitAt + 160; }

gate = at; total = at + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'airdrop') {

// ── Airdrop: grab beside the grappled creature, climb with it, let go at the top, it slams into the floor ──

const tk = FOES[0], Tk = TOK[tk], f = feet(Tk), s = G.s(tk);

const DEST = (() => { const p = front(tk, cfg.grabGap); return { x: p.x, y: p.y + 2 * KP }; })();

const GRAB = cfg.grab, CLIMB = GRAB, TOP = CLIMB + cfg.climb, DROP = TOP + 150, LAND = DROP + cfg.drop, RET = LAND + 250;

total = RET + cfg.ret + 200; gate = LAND;

const UP = cfg.climbLift * KP, UPT = cfg.carryLift * KP;

body(0, RET + cfg.ret, (t) => {

if (t < GRAB) return walk(t, 0, GRAB, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 40);

const at = { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y };

if (t < RET) { at.air = UP * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); return at; }

const w = walk(t, RET, cfg.ret, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 0); w.air = UP * (1 - E.sine(seg(t, RET, RET + cfg.ret))); return w; });

S_(GRAB, A.sfx.blowL, 0.4); G.hit(GRAB, tk, 'normal', false);

S_(CLIMB, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

m.hold(CLIMB, LAND, (e, S) => { const t = e + CLIMB; const q = S.tok[tk]; let air;

if (t < TOP) air = UPT * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); else if (t < DROP) air = UPT; else air = UPT * (1 - E.inC(seg(t, DROP, LAND))); q.air += air; });

G.shadow(DROP, 350, LAND, f, 40, s);

S_(LAND, A.sfx.land, 0.6); S_(LAND, A.sfx.blowL, 0.6); m.shake(LAND, 360, 14);

G.dust(LAND, f, { n: 18, s: s * 1.3 }); G.ring(LAND, f, { r1: 160, w: 8, s }); G.crack(LAND, f, s);

G.hit(LAND, tk, 'strong');

}

if (MOVE === 'airblast') {

// ── Air Blast: wind gathers at his hand, a green-white wind ball flies to the target and bursts ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk);

G.wisps(0, hand(), { n: 10, r: 90, ms: 400 }); S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.4);

const BALL = 450; S_(BALL, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

const HIT = G.fly(BALL, hand(), c, { ms: 480, arc: 40, ease: E.sine, draw: G.SHAPE.wind(24) });

m.clip('wind1', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('wind1', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5);

G.ring(HIT, feet(TOK[tk]), { rgb: '200,255,220', s });

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

gate = HIT; total = HIT + 400 + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'aerialshock') {

// ── Aerial Shockwave: a wing sweep, then three wind crescents in quick succession, one per target ──

body(0, 320, (t) => { const q = t < 160 ? squash(t, 0, 160, [1, 1], [1.1, 0.88]) : squash(t, 160, 160, [1.1, 0.88], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

const C0 = 320; let last = C0;

FOES.slice(0, 3).forEach((k, i) => { const at = C0 + i * 170; S_(at, A.sfx.wind7, 0.45);

const hit = G.fly(at, hand(), G.center(k), { ms: 380, draw: G.SHAPE.crs });

m.clip('wind2', hit, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('wind2', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hit, A.sfx.slash2, 0.3); G.hit(hit, k, 'normal'); last = at + 170; });

gate = last + 450; total = gate + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'turbulence') {

// ── Turbulence Wind: a wind spiral under each target and a light shake, then the debuff beat. No damage. ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5); G.rumble(0, 700, 2);

for (const k of FOES) { const s = G.s(k), f = feet(TOK[k]);

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) G.ring(0, f, { rgb: '190,255,215', r0: 60, r1: 10, ms: 700, s });

G.wisps(0, G.center(k), { n: 8, r: 70, ms: 600 });

m.clip('powerdown', 700, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: clipW('powerdown', 1), z: 30 }); }

gate = 700; total = 700 + 600 + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'windwall') {

// ── Wind Wall: a pale wind curtain rises in front of his own side, then the buff beat ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

const xw = kf.x + DIR * cfg.wallAhead * KP, ST = tl.STAGE;

for (let at = 0; at < 1300; at += 40) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const x = xw + rnd(-30, 30) * KP, y0 = ST.y + ST.h * rnd(250 / 788, 650 / 788), vy = rnd(0.25, 0.5) * KP, life = rnd(500, 900), r = rnd(30, 70) * KP;

G.add(at, life, 34, (g, e, t) => { const y = y0 - vy * e; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,255,230,' + (0.5 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI)) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 2 * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + 14 * KP, y - r / 2, x, y - r); g.stroke(); }); }

m.clip('powerup', 1300, { x: kf.x, y: kf.y, w: clipW('powerup', 1), z: 3 }); S_(1300, A.sfx.powerup, 0.35 / 0.75);

gate = 1300; total = 1300 + 800 + 300;

}

ZP.once(m, gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, sfx, onStart: () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } } });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Talon" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// Turbulence Wind — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"turbulence","talonGap":90,"lunge":380,"back":420,"grabGap":40,"grab":420,"climb":700,"climbLift":260,"carryLift":220,"drop":360,"ret":700,"wallAhead":240,"casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"seed":1170,"volume":0.9,"totalTimeoutMs":20000};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"powerdown":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/054_powerdown_1.webm","w":508,"h":656,"dur":867,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.628,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"overdrive":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav","shukuchi":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav","flash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Flash2.ogg","wind1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind1.ogg","wind4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","wind7":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg","damage5":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg","land":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_JUMPLANDA.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","slash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash2.ogg","evade":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Evasion1.ogg","powerup":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Powerup.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-gryphon-turbulence-wind";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Turbulence Wind]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

G.hit(LAND, tk, 'strong');

}

if (MOVE === 'airblast') {

// ── Air Blast: wind gathers at his hand, a green-white wind ball flies to the target and bursts ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk);

G.wisps(0, hand(), { n: 10, r: 90, ms: 400 }); S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.4);

const BALL = 450; S_(BALL, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

m.clip('wind1', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('wind1', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5);

G.ring(HIT, feet(TOK[tk]), { rgb: '200,255,220', s });

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

gate = HIT; total = HIT + 400 + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'aerialshock') {

// ── Aerial Shockwave: a wing sweep, then three wind crescents in quick succession, one per target ──

body(0, 320, (t) => { const q = t < 160 ? squash(t, 0, 160, [1, 1], [1.1, 0.88]) : squash(t, 160, 160, [1.1, 0.88], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

const C0 = 320; let last = C0;

FOES.slice(0, 3).forEach((k, i) => { const at = C0 + i * 170; S_(at, A.sfx.wind7, 0.45);

const hit = G.fly(at, hand(), G.center(k), { ms: 380, draw: G.SHAPE.crs });

m.clip('wind2', hit, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('wind2', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hit, A.sfx.slash2, 0.3); G.hit(hit, k, 'normal'); last = at + 170; });

gate = last + 450; total = gate + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'turbulence') {

// ── Turbulence Wind: a wind spiral under each target and a light shake, then the debuff beat. No damage. ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind1, 0.5); G.rumble(0, 700, 2);

for (const k of FOES) { const s = G.s(k), f = feet(TOK[k]);

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) G.ring(0, f, { rgb: '190,255,215', r0: 60, r1: 10, ms: 700, s });

G.wisps(0, G.center(k), { n: 8, r: 70, ms: 600 });

m.clip('powerdown', 700, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: clipW('powerdown', 1), z: 30 }); }

gate = 700; total = 700 + 600 + 300;

}

if (MOVE === 'windwall') {

// ── Wind Wall: a pale wind curtain rises in front of his own side, then the buff beat ──

S_(0, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

const xw = kf.x + DIR * cfg.wallAhead * KP, ST = tl.STAGE;

for (let at = 0; at < 1300; at += 40) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const x = xw + rnd(-30, 30) * KP, y0 = ST.y + ST.h * rnd(250 / 788, 650 / 788), vy = rnd(0.25, 0.5) * KP, life = rnd(500, 900), r = rnd(30, 70) * KP;

G.add(at, life, 34, (g, e, t) => { const y = y0 - vy * e; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,255,230,' + (0.5 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI)) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 2 * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + 14 * KP, y - r / 2, x, y - r); g.stroke(); }); }

m.clip('powerup', 1300, { x: kf.x, y: kf.y, w: clipW('powerup', 1), z: 3 }); S_(1300, A.sfx.powerup, 0.35 / 0.75);

gate = 1300; total = 1300 + 800 + 300;

}

ZP.once(m, gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, sfx, onStart: () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } } });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"wind2":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/092_wind_one_2.webm","w":816,"h":816,"dur":733,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.4853,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"overdrive":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav","shukuchi":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav","flash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Flash2.ogg","wind1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind1.ogg","wind4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","wind7":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg","damage5":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg","land":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_JUMPLANDA.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","slash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash2.ogg","evade":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Evasion1.ogg","powerup":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Powerup.ogg"}};

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Gryphon kit (legacy boss port, 2026-11-16) ─────────────────────────────────

// Canvas-2D ports of the legacy-boss mockup's shared kit (part-common.js / part-engine.js) that the

// Gryphon's moves use: wind wisps, floor rings, dust, cracks, a growing floor shadow, a drawn crescent,

// projectiles (dart / wind ball / wind crescent), horizontal speed lines, rumble, afterimage ghosts.

// Every helper schedules timeline tracks at an absolute time (ms) instead of running in real time.

// Sizes are mockup px (1682 px stage) times KP; s = the depth factor of the body the effect sits on.

// Prepended after _zpkit (ZP.once / ZP.hit / ZP.flinchTok / ZP.cutin). No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const GK = {};

GK.make = (tl, m, KP, seed) => {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const R = tl.rng(seed || 77);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const K = {};

K.rnd = rnd;

const glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7); g.fill(); };

K.glow = glow;

// one particle = one track; fn(g, ageMs, u 0..1). comp: 'lighter' (the mockup particle default) or 'source-over'

const add = (at, life, z, fn, comp) => m.hold(at, at + life, (e, S) => { S.world.push({ z, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = comp || 'lighter'; try { fn(g, e, Math.min(1, e / life)); } catch (er) {} g.restore(); } }); });

K.add = add;

// depth factor of a timeline token relative to the caster ('k'), times KP

K.s = (k) => { const T = TOK[k]; if (!T || !TOK.k) return KP; return KP * tl.depthRatio(feet(TOK.k), feet(T)); };

K.center = (k) => { const T = TOK[k], f = feet(T); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - T.h * 0.5 }; };

K.feet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

// floor ring (ground layer, under the bodies)

K.ring = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy || 0.3, w = o.w || 6, s = o.s || KP;

add(at, ms, 2, (g, e, t) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, E.outC(t)) * s; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - t) + ')'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, w * (1 - t * 0.6) * s); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, Math.max(0.1, r), Math.max(0.1, r * sy), 0, 0, 7); g.stroke(); }); };

// ground cracks

K.crack = (at, pt, s) => { s = s || KP; const segs = []; for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) segs.push([rnd(0, Math.PI * 2), rnd(30, 80)]);

add(at, 1600, 3, (g, e, t) => { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,18,10,' + (t > 0.7 ? (1 - t) / 0.3 * 0.8 : 0.8) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3 * s;

for (const sg of segs) { const a = sg[0], L = sg[1]; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y); g.lineTo(pt.x + Math.cos(a) * L * s * 0.5, pt.y + Math.sin(a) * L * s * 0.16); g.lineTo(pt.x + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * L * s, pt.y + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * L * s * 0.32); g.stroke(); } }, 'source-over'); };

// dust puffs thrown up and out from a point (velocity decays with drag .97 per 16 ms)

K.dust = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, s = o.s || KP, rgb = o.rgb || '190,170,140'; const dk = -Math.log(0.97) / 16;

K.wisps = (at, to, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, rr = (o.r == null ? 220 : o.r) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '200,255,225', ms = o.ms || 700, arc = 60 * KP, pr = 2 * KP;

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rnd(0, Math.PI * 2); const from = { x: to.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y: to.y + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.6 };

K.crescent = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const ang = o.ang == null ? -0.5 : o.ang, len = (o.len || 160) * KP, w = (o.w || 26) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', ms = o.ms || 260, dir = o.dir || 1;

add(at, ms, 42, (g, e, t) => { const k = E.outC(Math.min(1, t * 1.6)); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.scale(dir, 1); g.rotate(ang); g.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, (t - 0.45) / 0.55);

g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',.9)'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len / 2, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -w * 1.6 * k, len / 2 * k, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -w * 0.4, -len / 2, 0); g.fill();

glow(g, 0, -w * 0.5, len * 0.45, rgb, 0.35); }); };

// a projectile from -> to over ms (ease), arcing up by arc px; draw(g, ageMs) with the tip at 0,0 pointing +x. Returns the arrival time.

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { o = o || {}; const ms = o.ms || 450, ease = o.ease || E.lin, arc = (o.arc || 0) * KP, draw = o.draw, sc = o.scale || KP;

const pos = (q) => { const u = ease(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, q))); return { x: lerp(from.x, to.x, u), y: lerp(from.y, to.y, u) - arc * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) }; };

add(at, ms, o.z || 44, (g, e) => { const p = pos(e / ms), q = pos((e - 16) / ms); let an = Math.atan2(p.y - q.y, p.x - q.x); if (!(Math.abs(p.x - q.x) + Math.abs(p.y - q.y) > 0.01)) an = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(an); g.scale(sc, sc); draw(g, e); });

K.SHAPE = {

dart: (g) => { g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#f4f1ea'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(-8, 0, 13, 3.2, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#8a6a4a'; g.fillRect(-22, -0.8, 12, 1.6); glow(g, 0, 0, 10, '220,255,230', 0.5); },

wind: (r, rgb) => { r = r || 26; rgb = rgb || '190,255,215'; return (g, e) => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.8 - i * 0.15) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, r * (1 - i * 0.18), e / 60 + i * 1.6, e / 60 + i * 1.6 + 3.6); g.stroke(); } glow(g, 0, 0, r * 1.2, rgb, 0.6); }; },

crs: (g) => { g.rotate(Math.PI / 2); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,255,225,.9)'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-34, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -30, 34, 0); g.quadraticCurveTo(0, -12, -34, 0); g.fill(); glow(g, 0, -10, 36, '160,255,200', 0.4); },

};

// horizontal speed lines over the screen (mockup speedLines, angle 0 / PI)

K.speedLines = (at, end, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 26, color = o.color || '255,255,255', alpha = o.alpha == null ? 0.5 : o.alpha, ang = o.angle || 0;

const L = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) L.push({ u: R(), off: rnd(-1, 1), len: rnd(0.15, 0.45), sp: rnd(0.0015, 0.003), w: rnd(1, 3.2) });

m.hold(at, end, (e, S) => { S.screen.push({ draw: (g) => { const k = g.W / 1682, ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang), nx = -sa, ny = ca; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

for (const l of L) { let u = (l.u + 0.3 + l.sp * e) % 1.6 - 0.3; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + color + ',' + (alpha * (0.4 + l.w / 4)) + ')'; g.lineWidth = l.w * k;

const along = (u * 2 - 1) * 1300 * k, perp = l.off * 900 * k; const x0 = g.W / 2 + ca * along + nx * perp, y0 = g.H / 2 + sa * along + ny * perp; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0, y0); g.lineTo(x0 + ca * l.len * 900 * k, y0 + sa * l.len * 900 * k); g.stroke(); }

g.restore(); } }); }); };

// a constant low rumble (mockup rumble(true, px) ... rumble(false))

K.rumble = (at, end, px) => m.hold(at, end, (e, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, px); });

// a ghost of a timeline token at a recorded pose {dx, dy, air, sx, sy, rot}, fading out over ms (mockup afterimage)

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const ms = o.ms || 380, op = o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, filter = o.filter || 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; const T = TOK[k], art = tl.art(k); if (!T || !art) return;

const f = feet(T); const r = (pose.dx || pose.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(f, { x: f.x + (pose.dx || 0), y: f.y + (pose.dy || 0) }) : 1;

add(at, ms, o.z == null ? 4 : o.z, (g, e, t) => { g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.globalAlpha = op * (1 - t); g.filter = filter; g.translate(T.x + (pose.dx || 0), f.y + (pose.dy || 0) - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot);

g.scale(T.flip * (pose.sx || 1) * r, (pose.sy || 1) * r); g.drawImage(art, -T.w / 2, -T.h * T.foot, T.w, T.h); }, 'source-over'); };

// the hover the real token is drawn with (Flying / idle Float lift, TokenMagic), in drawn px: a painted copy carries it

const HOV = {};

K.hover = (k) => { if (k in HOV) return HOV[k]; let v = 0; try { const T = TOK[k], api = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.spriteShadow.airborne; if (T && T.token && api && typeof api.liftOf === 'function') v = Math.max(0, Number(api.liftOf(T.token)) || 0) * (T.m3d || 1); } catch (e) { v = 0; } HOV[k] = v; return v; };

// the game's hurt reaction on a painted target + its strike cue (number reveal in a Chain; ignored otherwise).

// noHover: the shot already lifts this body by its hover over the window.

K.hit = (at, k, tier, cue, noHover) => { ZP.flinchTok(m, at, k, tier || 'normal', 900); if (cue !== false) ZP.hit(m, at, { numbersOnly: true }); const h = noHover ? 0 : K.hover(k); if (h > 0) m.hold(at, at + 900, (e, S) => { S.tok[k].air += h; }); };

return K;

};

// ── shot ──

// ── Gryphon · filler moves (shot) ───────────────────────────────────────────────

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup: Talon, Razor Plume, Airdrop, Air Blast, Aerial Shockwave,

// Turbulence Wind, Wind Wall. cfg.move picks one. LIVE board: the camera is never touched, only the

// bodies a beat moves are painted. Each move fires the damage gate where the mockup marks it.

// Every number is in cfg (mockup px on a 1682 px stage, x KP). No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const NEEDS = { talon: 1, razorplume: 1, airdrop: 1, airblast: 1, aerialshock: 1, turbulence: 1, windwall: 0 };

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.slice(0, cfg.maxTargets || 8).forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

if (NEEDS[MOVE] && !FOES.length) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const CL = A.clips || {};

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: CL, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const G = GK.make(tl, m, KP, cfg.seed || 1170);

const rnd = G.rnd;

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at, url, v: v * cfg.volume }); };

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * CL[key].k * scale * KP;

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.x <= tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w / 2 ? 1 : -1);

// his "hand" (where wind and darts leave him): ahead of his middle, 62 % up his body

const hand = (air) => ({ x: kf.x + DIR * K.w * 0.3, y: kf.y - (air || 0) - K.h * 0.62 });

// a point in front of a target, on his side

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * G.s(k), y: f.y }; };

// his body track: fn(t) -> { dx, dy, air, sx, sy } or null (untouched)

const body = (t0, t1, fn) => m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => { const o = fn(e + t0); if (!o) return; const q = S.tok.k; q.dx += o.dx || 0; q.dy += o.dy || 0; q.air += o.air || 0; q.sx *= o.sx || 1; q.sy *= o.sy || 1; });

const squash = (t, a, ms, from, to) => { const u = E.outQ(seg(t, a, a + ms)); return [lerp(from[0], to[0], u), lerp(from[1], to[1], u)]; };

// a move along the floor from p0 to p1 with an optional hop (mockup moveActor)

const walk = (t, a, ms, p0, p1, ease, hop) => { const u = seg(t, a, a + ms), e = ease(u); return { dx: lerp(p0.x, p1.x, e) - kf.x, dy: lerp(p0.y, p1.y, e) - kf.y, air: Math.sin(e * Math.PI) * (hop || 0) * KP }; };

const HOME = { x: kf.x, y: kf.y };

let total = 0, gate = 0;

if (MOVE === 'talon') {

// ── Talon: a short hopping lunge, a three-claw rake, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = G.center(tk), s = G.s(tk), Tk = TOK[tk], tf = feet(Tk);

const DEST = front(tk, cfg.talonGap);

const L = cfg.lunge, RAKE = L, HIT = RAKE + 3 * 70, BACK = HIT + 300;

total = BACK + cfg.back; gate = HIT;

body(0, total, (t) => { if (t < L) return walk(t, 0, L, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 30); if (t < BACK) return { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y }; return walk(t, BACK, cfg.back, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 30); });

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const at = RAKE + i * 70;

G.crescent(at, { x: tf.x - DIR * 10 * s + DIR * i * 12 * s, y: tf.y - Tk.h * (0.7 - i * 0.15) }, { ang: 0.9, len: 120, w: 14, dir: DIR }); S_(at, A.sfx.slash1, 0.4); }

m.clip('claw', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('claw', 1), z: 40 }); S_(HIT, A.sfx.blowL, 0.5);

G.hit(HIT, tk, 'normal');

}

if (MOVE === 'razorplume') {

// ── Razor Plume: a wing flap, then a fan of five feather darts at each target in turn ──

const FL = 140 + 160; S_(0, A.sfx.wind7, 0.5);

body(0, FL, (t) => { const q = t < 140 ? squash(t, 0, 140, [1, 1], [1.08, 0.9]) : squash(t, 140, 160, [1.08, 0.9], [1, 1]); return { sx: q[0], sy: q[1] }; });

let at = FL;

for (const k of FOES.slice(0, 2)) { const f = feet(TOK[k]), Tk = TOK[k], s = G.s(k);

for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) G.fly(at, hand(), { x: f.x + rnd(-20, 20) * s, y: f.y - Tk.h * rnd(0.3, 0.7) }, { ms: 300 + i * 25, draw: G.SHAPE.dart, arc: rnd(-30, 30) });

S_(at, A.sfx.evade, 0.4);

const hitAt = at + 320; m.clip('hit_phys', hitAt, { x: G.center(k).x, y: G.center(k).y, w: clipW('hit_phys', 1), z: 40 }); S_(hitAt, A.sfx.slash1, 0.35); G.hit(hitAt, k, 'normal');

at = hitAt + 160; }

gate = at; total = at + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'airdrop') {

// ── Airdrop: grab beside the grappled creature, climb with it, let go at the top, it slams into the floor ──

const tk = FOES[0], Tk = TOK[tk], f = feet(Tk), s = G.s(tk);

const DEST = (() => { const p = front(tk, cfg.grabGap); return { x: p.x, y: p.y + 2 * KP }; })();

const GRAB = cfg.grab, CLIMB = GRAB, TOP = CLIMB + cfg.climb, DROP = TOP + 150, LAND = DROP + cfg.drop, RET = LAND + 250;

total = RET + cfg.ret + 200; gate = LAND;

const UP = cfg.climbLift * KP, UPT = cfg.carryLift * KP;

body(0, RET + cfg.ret, (t) => {

if (t < GRAB) return walk(t, 0, GRAB, HOME, DEST, E.ioQ, 40);

const at = { dx: DEST.x - kf.x, dy: DEST.y - kf.y };

if (t < RET) { at.air = UP * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); return at; }

const w = walk(t, RET, cfg.ret, DEST, HOME, E.ioQ, 0); w.air = UP * (1 - E.sine(seg(t, RET, RET + cfg.ret))); return w; });

S_(GRAB, A.sfx.blowL, 0.4); G.hit(GRAB, tk, 'normal', false);

S_(CLIMB, A.sfx.wind4, 0.5);

m.hold(CLIMB, LAND, (e, S) => { const t = e + CLIMB; const q = S.tok[tk]; let air;

if (t < TOP) air = UPT * E.sine(seg(t, CLIMB, TOP)); else if (t < DROP) air = UPT; else air = UPT * (1 - E.inC(seg(t, DROP, LAND))); q.air += air; });

G.shadow(DROP, 350, LAND, f, 40, s);

S_(LAND, A.sfx.land, 0.6); S_(LAND, A.sfx.blowL, 0.6); m.shake(LAND, 360, 14);

G.dust(LAND, f, { n: 18, s: s * 1.3 }); G.ring(LAND, f, { r1: 160, w: 8, s }); G.crack(LAND, f, s);

G.hit(LAND, tk, 'strong');

}
